test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which Article of the Constitution of India lays down qualifications for the membership of the Parliament?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Article 84**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 84** of the **Constitution of India** specifies the qualifications required for membership of **Parliament**.
 
• According to this Article, a person must be a **citizen of India** to be eligible for election as a member of Parliament.
 
• The person must not be less than **25 years of age** for the House of the People (Lok Sabha) and **30 years of age** for the Council of States (Rajya Sabha).
 
• He/she must possess such other qualifications as may be prescribed by or under any law made by **Parliament**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Article 105**__

 __
 
• **Article 105** deals with the **powers, privileges, and immunities of Parliament** and its members.
 
• This Article grants freedom of speech in Parliament and immunity from legal action for anything said or any vote cast in Parliament.
 
 
 
• **Article 85**__
 __
 
• **Article 85** pertains to the **sessions of Parliament**, **prorogation** and **dissolution**.
 
• It mandates that the President shall summon each House of Parliament at such intervals that there should not be more than **six months gap between the last sitting** in one session and the date appointed for its sitting in the next session.
 
 
 
• **Article 80**__
 
 
• **Article 80** deals with the **composition of the Council of States (Rajya Sabha)**.
 
• It specifies the number of members, their election/nomination, and the representation of States and Union territories.
